name: com.getmcpads/amazon-ads
title: Amazon Ads
description: Amazon Ads MCP server: 31 read tools, 77 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Login with Amazon client ID of an application with Amazon Ads API access.

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of that Login with Amazon security profile. Keep it secret.

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token (Atzr|...) granted to that client. Renewed in memory only.

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_ADS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: API region of the profiles: NA, EU or FE.

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_ADS_PROFILE_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated advertising profile IDs this server may use. Required even for reads.

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true exposes the write tools, which preview first. Defaults to false.
